skill_name: Talk about Michelangelo's life without mentioning his works.
workflow: Michelangelo was born in 1475 in a Tuscan town near Florence, Italy. He was the son of a government administrator, and studied sculpture and painting from a young age. Although he was trained in the traditional painter's techniques, he also had a passionate quest for learning. His curiosity and interest in the sciences and literature was extraordinary for his age. During his life, he traveled around Europe, and had the opportunity to work for some of the most important patrons of the Renaissance
